governance.parent: Taipei City Government Department of Cultural Affairs

basis: The museum's organisation page (updated 25 April 2025) says it belongs to the Taipei City Government Department of Cultural Affairs and is a second-level agency of the city government.
The about page says C-LAB is run by the Taiwan Living Aesthetics Foundation, a foundation of the Ministry of Culture, and the governance page lists the Vice Minister of Culture as board chair.
The about page says TheCube is a non-profit art organization registered under the Taipei City self-government ordinance for performing arts groups.

governance.parent: Executive Office of the President of Tajikistan

basis: The museum's own about page calls it a state institution of the Executive Office of the President, founded by Presidential decree no. 1094 of 27 July 2011.
The about page says Nafasi is registered as an NGO under the NGO Act of Tanzania (2002) and that its voluntary board is in charge of overall governance.
The foundation's mission page calls it a non-profit foundation founded in 2017, and its foundation page lists the board members.

The centre's about page says it is under the supervision of the Bangkok Art and Culture Centre Foundation, which was established with Bangkok Metropolitan Administration support; the 2018 announcement says the Foundation appointed the director to work under its board (archive copies, as the live site refuses curl).

The foundation's page says the Art Center is one of the activities the James H.W. Thompson Foundation operates, under a seven-member Board of Trustees, and that the foundation was set up in 1975 from Jim Thompson's estate.
